</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

This leads to delays in reporting and uncertainty over which figures are accurate.\n\n## Who is affected\n- **Finance teams** at customer companies, who question which figure is correct and experience delays in month-end reporting due to the mismatch [i:2e7168b298e234f6][i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed].\n- **Account managers and support teams** at Keelwater, who field questions and concerns about the data inconsistency from multiple accounts [i:1258088ddf027b73][i:4a12350cd4d4f040][i:4c1e1128bbb746cc].\n- **Users performing exports**, who encounter error exceptions when clicking Export CSV [i:2a7e1476a88e0d6b][i:af53900dbe330570].\n\n## Evidence\n- The issue has been raised by **7 accounts** [i:1258088ddf027b73][i:2a7e1476a88e0d6b][i:2e7168b298e234f6][i:4a12350cd4d4f040][i:4c1e1128bbb746cc][i:551e3ef68cf180fa][i:79dbb87fe13aebb4].\n- There have been **16 mentions** of the problem across **4 routes** [i:1258088ddf027b73][i:2a7e1476a88e0d6b][i:2e7168b298e234f6][i:69ced11dd0bfa22c].\n- The affected accounts represent a total **ARR of £7,050,000** [i:1258088ddf027b73][i:2a7e1476a88e0d6b][i:2e7168b298e234f6][i:4a12350cd4d4f040][i:4c1e1128bbb746cc][i:551e3ef68cf180fa][i:79dbb87fe13aebb4].\n- Customers report that the mismatch causes finance teams to distrust the numbers, leading to delays in month-end reporting [i:551e3ef68cf180fa][i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed]. A user from Marrowgate Commercial noted re-exporting yielded consistent but incorrect figures due to a UTC cutoff, not UK time [i:ccfc25a70dd3f36d].\n- The problem is not isolated; multiple accounts, including Stannary Commercial, Ashcombe Property Mutual, Tidewell Marine & Cargo, Thistlecombe Mutual, Marrowgate Commercial, Quillon Business Insurance, and Hollinbrook Home Insurance, have reported it [i:a255850743918c2d][i:2a7e1476a88e0d6b][i:a4003abdfc3b22b1][i:4a12350cd4d4f040][i:4c1e1128bbb746cc][i:a55ec8b98884a144][i:b1b2bbb73778ed91].\n\n## Why now\n- **5 renewals** are due within the next 90 days as of 2026-11-03 [i:1258088ddf027b73][i:2a7e1476a88e0d6b][i:4c1e1128bbb746cc].\n- The issue has been actively reported by customers over the last two months, with a concentration of mentions in October 2026, indicating it is a current and pressing operational blocker [i:2e7168b298e234f6][i:4c1e1128bbb746cc][i:551e3ef68cf180fa][i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed].\n- The data inconsistency directly impacts financial reporting cycles, which are often most critical at month-end and quarter-end, times when the recent mentions have clustered [i:551e3ef68cf180fa][i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed].",

response.content: {"critique": "I checked every claim against the cited insights and fact sheet. All figures match: 7 accounts, 16 mentions across 4 routes, total ARR of £7,050,000, and 5 renewals within 90 days of 2026-11-03 (2026-11-30, 2026-12-05, 2026-12-12, 2027-01-15, 2027-01-20). The finance-team impact, month-end reporting delays, error exceptions on Export CSV (Ashcombe sessions), and the Marrowgate UTC-cutoff quote are all directly supported by cited insights, and the account-name list correctly names the seven accounts. Temporal claims ('last two months', 'concentration in October 2026') are consistent with the insight dates (2026-09-04 to 2026-10-27). No overstatements, misquoted paraphrases, or contrary evidence found.", "verdict": "pass"}
